declared_rule: individual_supported: >=100 occurrence records, >=5 years, >=20 observed weeks, >=10 0.5-degree cells; partially_pooled: >=25 records, >=3 years, >=10 weeks, >=3 cells; otherwise group_only if records exist; no_activity_evidence if none.
critical_limitation: GBIF records are opportunistic positive occurrences. Cohorts support relative seasonal occurrence/activity evidence only; they do not convert unobserved grid-weeks into absences, abundance, health, or causal response.
next_modeling_policy: Fit individual seasonal models only for individual_supported species; use partial pooling only for partially_pooled species; group_only species must remain indirect and high-uncertainty; no_activity_evidence species receive no GBIF-derived activity score.
